answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy makes duplication expensive and detectable. Each persona posts collateral that is burned if audit reveals it to be a hollow karst of fake identities, so cloning no longer pays. Honest work rises to a mesa of cumulative attestation only through real effort, and the signed record lets anyone replay it to catch copycats. Governance then keeps a single harbor: one established agent, one vote, so a fabricated fleet buys no power.
